ManualLayout.metaDescription: Looking for a way to handle a lost, found, or stolen item? We've organized the reporting steps and contacts by type so you can stay calm and act with confidence.

policeRecord.title: Have you checked the police lost-item records?
policeRecord.content: Check the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr/) for lost items currently held by the police.

lostPost.title: Have you posted a lost item listing?
lostPost.content: Post a lost item on Finditem so whoever found it can reach out to you through your listing.

policeFoundList.title: Have you checked the police found-item list?
policeFoundList.content: Check the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr/) for lost items currently held by the police.

creditCard.title: Did you lose a credit card?
creditCard.content:
If you lose a credit card, report it to the card issuer right away.

If you've lost multiple cards, you can use the integrated card-loss reporting service — reporting to just one issuer's customer center will register the loss with the other issuers too.



Corporate cards can't be reported through the integrated service even if issued under an individual's name, so they must be reported separately.

idCard.title: Did you lose your ID?
idCard.content:
For a resident registration card, visit your nearest community center in person, or file an online report at Minwon24 (www.minwon.go.kr).



If you lost your driver's license, visit a nearby police station or driver's license test center to report the loss and apply for reissue.

phone.title: Did you lose your phone?
phone.content:
Report the loss and suspend the line through your carrier's customer center (114), an authorized store, or the carrier's website.



You can also search for found phones through the Phone Finder Call Center (https://www.handphone.or.kr).

policeRecord.title: Have you checked the police lost-item records?
policeRecord.content: Check the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr) for items reported as lost.

foundPost.title: Have you posted a found item listing?
foundPost.content: Post a found item on Finditem so whoever lost it can reach out to you through your listing and reclaim it.

foundReport.title: Have you reported the found item?
foundReport.content: If you've found an item, you can report it through the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr) or at your nearest police station.

policeItems.title: Have you checked the police found-item list?
policeItems.content: Start by checking the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr) for items currently held by the police.

cctv.title: Want to check CCTV footage?
cctv.content:
Visit your nearest police station to file a theft report, then request CCTV access directly from whoever manages the location where the theft occurred.



For CCTV in public spaces, you can request access by filing an information disclosure request through the Information Disclosure Portal (https://www.open.go.kr).
cctv.btnText: Go to the Information Disclosure Portal

SupportLayout.title: FAQ
SupportLayout.description: Curious about finditem? Find answers to common questions about finding lost items, posting, and more, all in one place.

SupportFaqAccordion.question1: What kind of platform is finditem?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer1:
finditem is a lost-and-found matching platform that quickly connects lost items with found ones.
You can register a lost item or a found item to share information with other users, and use posts to find an item's owner or reach out directly to whoever found it.
SupportFaqAccordion.question2: How can I find a lost item?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer2:
On the [Post List], you can browse posts using filters for region, category, sorting, and found status.
You can also check posts near you using the map on the main page to see if anything found nearby matches what you lost.
SupportFaqAccordion.question3: Is the service free to use?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer3:
finditem is completely free to use.
Posting, searching, chatting, and every other feature are available at no cost.
SupportFaqAccordion.answer4:
You need to sign up and log in to use the service.
Once logged in, you can write a post about a lost item or a found item.
SupportFaqAccordion.question5: How long do posts stay up?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer5:
A post stays on the service until you delete it or change its status yourself.
If you've found the item, you can change the post's status or delete it.
SupportFaqAccordion.question6: What should I do if I run into a problem while using the service?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer6:
If you run into an error or need help while using the service, you can reach out through 1:1 Inquiry.
We'll get back to you with guidance as soon as we can.
SupportFaqAccordion.answer7:
On the [Sign Up page], you can join using your email or a Kakao account.
Once you enter the required information and complete sign-up, you can start using the service.
SupportFaqAccordion.answer8:
First, make sure you entered your email and password correctly.
If the problem continues, try resetting your password or contact us through 1:1 Inquiry.
SupportFaqAccordion.answer9:
On the [Log In page], you can set a new password using the password reset feature.
Enter the email address you signed up with to receive password reset instructions.
SupportFaqAccordion.question10: How do I log in with Kakao?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer10: On the [Log In page], select the Kakao Login button to log in easily using your Kakao account.
SupportFaqAccordion.question11: How do I delete my account?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer11:
You can delete your account from My Page.
After deletion, you can't sign up again for 7 days, and your account information is permanently deleted once those 7 days pass.
SupportFaqAccordion.question12: Can I recover my account after deleting it?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer12:
Once your account is deleted, your account information is removed and can't be recovered.
You'll need to sign up again to use the service.
SupportFaqAccordion.question13: Where can I edit my info?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer13: You can edit your profile image and nickname on the profile settings page in My Page.
SupportFaqAccordion.question14: How do I post that I lost something?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer14:
On the [Report Lost Item page], you can register information about your lost item.
Adding where you lost it, the item's features, and photos helps other users find it.
SupportFaqAccordion.question15: How do I post that I found something?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer15:
On the Report Found Item page, you can register information about the item you found.
Adding where you found it, the item's features, and photos helps the owner confirm it's theirs.
SupportFaqAccordion.question16: How do I edit a post?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer16: You can edit a post you wrote from its detail page.
SupportFaqAccordion.question17: How do I delete a post?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer17: You can delete a post you wrote from its detail page.
SupportFaqAccordion.question18: How do I contact the other person?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer18: You can reach out to the other person using the chat feature on the post's detail page.
SupportFaqAccordion.question19: How do I start a chat?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer19: You can reach out to the other person using the chat feature on the post's detail page.
SupportFaqAccordion.question20: What do I do once I've found my item?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer20: If you've found your item, you can handle it by changing the post's status or deleting the post.
SupportFaqAccordion.question21: How many photos can I add to a post?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer21:
You can add up to 5 photos to a post.
Adding photos helps convey the item's features more accurately.
SupportFaqAccordion.question22: How do I set the location?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer22:
When writing a post, you can set the location by selecting it on the map.
Setting an accurate location helps your post reach more users nearby.
SupportFaqAccordion.question23: How do I report an inappropriate post?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer23:
You can report an inappropriate post using the report feature on its detail page.
Reported posts are reviewed by our team and handled according to our service policy.
SupportFaqAccordion.question24: What happens after I submit a report?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer24:
Once a report is submitted, our team reviews the content.
If a policy violation is confirmed, actions such as post deletion or usage restrictions may follow.
SupportFaqAccordion.question25: How is my personal information protected?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer25:
finditem protects your personal information in accordance with relevant laws and our privacy policy.
We collect only the minimum information necessary to provide the service and manage it securely.
SupportFaqAccordion.question26: Where can I ask questions while using the service?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer26:
If you run into a problem or need help while using the service, you can reach out through Inquiry.
We'll review your inquiry and get back to you.
SupportFaqAccordion.question27: Can my use of the service be restricted?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer27:
If a violation of our service policy is confirmed, your use of the service may be restricted.
See our Terms of Service and operating policy for more details.
SupportFaqAccordion.answer28: You can check them on the [Notices page].
SupportFaqAccordion.question29: What happens when I block a user?
SupportFaqAccordion.answer29:
Once you block a user, their posts and chats no longer appear to you.
You can check users you've blocked on the [Blocked Users page] in My Page, and change their block status there.
